announcements.headline: Arqiva signs DCC contract through to 2037
announcements.insight: Securing the DCC contract through 2037 provides critical revenue visibility for Arqiva's digital switchover and transmission infrastructure business, mitigating near-term regulatory uncertainty in the UK broadcasting sector.
